snippet.title: Disgaea Mayhem - Demo Trailer (Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5 & Steam)
snippet.description:
Try action on for size with the demo for Disgaea Mayhem on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Steam—available today!

Players will get to tackle three stages using any of the seven different weapons featured in the full game. Do you prefer the versatile range of a bow or the satisfying heft of an axe? Find out by trying each weapon type before the game's full launch on July 23, 2026!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Preorder now @ https://nisamerica.com/disgaea-mayhem

#DisgaeaMayhem
